svg.title: Homebridge UI — Settings › Security › HTTPS (Mockup)
svg.desc: A comprehensive mockup of the HTTPS settings section showing HTTPS port, redirect toggle, HTTP port, SSL mode selector, validate button, self-signed hostnames input, generate actions, and certificate upload fields.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Configure HTTPS with default port 8581, optional HTTP redirect, SSL uploads, and self-signed generation.
